title: Can't login - frustrating
summary: During installation I assign an administrator and admin passwort to the icecast2 installation. Then I try to go to the administration page of icecast2 and I'm asked for credentials. Nothing works. No combination of assigned admin user, or yunohost admin account with used password works. This is frustrating, because Icecast2 is marked as working well for more than one year...
